**F2 reproduced, then corrected:** both unplanned-arm mutations rejected with `slot identity` but raised `StopIteration` in attachment/accounting before editing; the consistent control completed one synthetic comparison.
The narrow fix defaults the unmatched source-arm lookup to `None` and uses the existing invalid-attachment path; no exception handling or malformed-envelope scope was broadened.
[Expectations](artifacts/attempt-evidence-f2-expectations-0147.json) preceded all case execution; [results](artifacts/attempt-evidence-f2-results-0147.json) preserve pre/post source hashes, fixture identities, complete inventories, byte observations, adjudications and command exits.
After correction, both negatives retain two attempts, 48 payloads and full diagnostic accounting, mark the unmatched attachment `invalid`, and complete zero even with `consistent=True`; the positive still completes one.
`python3 -I benchmark/verify_attempt_evidence_f2_0147.py` exited 0: three F2 cases, one captured F1 run with eight cases, 92 saved controls and 60 grouping controls; pre-correction exit was 1 as expected.
Starting commit `2521702e334a00bef6976a5e6a0cb7c805d2a5d3`, tree `be4befb9101b389f0de953d9b7d67657de93938c`; starting checker and both reviewer input hashes match the required pins.
Export #669 and both inputs were available; its script's older-checker dependency was absent, so its exact mutation was recreated without reconstructing history.
Exactly three repository paths changed: the checker, [regression](../benchmark/verify_attempt_evidence_f2_0147.py) and [correction note](../benchmark/attempt-evidence-f2-0147.md); existing descriptions, JSON contracts, controls, source pins, grouping, denominators and selection semantics are unchanged.
Final checker SHA256: `6b14d20fea17acc580f30e7da0a7218e0b2b7579516f9396a0facf0a2028ab6a`; all changed-file hashes are in results. Diff whitespace and reverse-application checks passed against the starting pin.
An initial audit incorrectly assumed live HEAD still named the starting tree; parent-committed writes made it clean. The failed audit and corrected starting-pin audit are preserved in results.
All four required artifacts below exist locally for parent collection; no evaluator, runner, model, reader or native execution occurred and the 41-case review suite was not replayed.
Admissions, model/reader/native executions, scored runs, semantic passes and real comparisons remain zero; `benchmark_ready=false`.
Next: separate narrow F2 review using the saved evidence and patch; parent handles commits. Whole-method review and owner acceptance remain prerequisites; avoid historical reconstruction or reopening grouping work.
